metadata.description:
Okay, not technically a lake—but when you stand in front of Minnehaha Falls, watching 50 feet of water tumble into a gorge, you understand why it belongs here. This iconic cascade is one of the most photographed spots in Minnesota and a must-see for anyone who loves natural beauty. Just steps away, trails lead to the Mississippi, and picnic tables invite lazy afternoons. This Lake Lover POAP celebrates your visit to the roaring heart of the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Lake Lover 
GPS: 44.91533, -93.211 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.91533,-93.211
